bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (2019 Measures No. 3) Bill 2019

name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with the Senate amendments to this [bill](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6466). The bill will now return to the Senate to ask whether the Senate will insist on their amendments. If they do, the bill will not become law. If they do not, then it will pass without the Senate amendments. Read more about the amendments in the [House debate](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2020-06-15.29.2).
